# PLR Vault

PLR Vault (https://plrvault.mehyar.us) is a curated private-label-rights
bundle by MehyarSoft LLC: a 2026 planner pack, a 30-day content calendar,
50 email swipes, and mini-course outlines. $9.95 one-time. Preview the free
sampler before you buy. Buyers get PLR rights: rebrand the materials and
resell them as their own, keeping 100% of each sale.

## Key pages

- / — landing page with bundle contents, free sampler preview, and pricing
- /privacy — privacy policy
- /terms — terms of purchase (the PLR license)

## Pricing

- PLR Vault 5-pack resell bundle: $9.95 one-time via Stripe through the
  centralized https://mehyar.us/api/pay/checkout.
- Free sampler: a free preview pack, no purchase required.

## API

- Public API: none. Checkout is handled by the shared mehyar.us Stripe flow;
  delivery is token-gated.

## Compliance

- The license is described in plain words on /terms: what rebranding and
  reselling covers, and what it does not.
- No income claims, no "make money fast" promises, no testimonials,
  no earnings guarantees of any kind.
- The bundle contents are generic business templates, not legal, financial,
  or tax advice.
